title: JA Diner j6 1.0.8 is pinned on a stable Claude Cowork release carrying its hide review, and a release candidate pin moves on a slim release
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database, no network).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Both quickstarts.json pin quickstart/ja-diner/j6 on the same stable version, at least 0.24.96, and cowork-plugin-doors.json lists that package with the same sha256, every door and the ja-diner/j6/1.0.8 review.
A pin on X.Y.Z-rc.N moves to X.Y.Z on a slim release, each recorded profile checked from its own asset.

tests: JA Diner j6 is pinned on a stable Claude Cowork release, the same pin in both catalogues
the pinned package's hide review covers the JA Diner 1.0.8 contract, read from the same bytes
a slim release moves an existing RC pin to its stable version, each recorded profile checked from its own asset
